Best case (34,393 BCM day) still ends 67,530 BCM (182,331 t) short. Lost hours Oct 23, each unit's own BCM/h (t = BCM x 2.7). A&U basis: 51 h = about 13,753 BCM / 37,132 t (EX-263 3.5 h breakdown 976 BCM / 2,637 t and 9.5 h no-job standby 2,650 / 7,156; EX-123, EX-262, EX-340, EX-398 0.5 h each = 749 BCM / 2,023 t; estimates: EX-253 down 24 h at EX-263's 279 BCM/h = 6,696 BCM / 18,079 t, EX-247 12 h at EX-398's 223.38 BCM/h = 2,680 BCM / 7,238 t). Final Report basis (governs): 72 h = about 25,680 BCM / 69,335 t. Crusher 3.3 h = about 444 BCM / 1,200 t (estimate). Roster-break standby (inside the Friday target) about 20,656 BCM / 55,771 t. Basis: excavators 57.27% available (Final Report), 39% utilized (Client Meeting Report); trucks 88.46% / 42%; Client Meeting Report shows 95% and 98% availability. Overall 93.84% daily, 89.89% MTD. Plans: FINAL_v5 20.16 Mt (+160 kt vs 20 Mt; v3 20.18 Mt); Milestone v20 recovery cumulative 20.01 Mt; budget deck v34 why-behind 72,070 BCM / 194,589 t and 66,680 t/day required vs 57,468 t/day run rate. Rental fleet PO-009398: 6 x CAT 777E (2-4 Nov window) and 1 x CAT 6020B (16-19 Nov), 14 operators; PO approval outstanding, all Gantt tasks 0%. Ma'aden (Yahya Albarakati, 23-Oct) approves Ajeer manpower via Earth Pulse Mining with operator review, written JRAR responsibility and safety/security checks, and says the recovery plan is still awaited. Water tankers: pump engines fail from 24/7 duty; PTO hydraulic conversion proposed. Rental water truck 5952 EBA condemned (missing licence, insurance, registration). LV-048 failure report: shock/bracket/banjo bolt damage, 19 tires YTD. Contradictions flagged, not resolved: excavator availability 57.27% vs 95% (EX-262 24.5 h down vs 2,325 BCM produced); Friday ore 14,731 / 13,476 / 12,973.5 t; strip ratio 1.29 vs 1.02; broken stock 244 kt vs 304 kt; LV-48 breakdown vs near miss; 6 vs 10 rental trucks and 6020B vs 6028; recovery landing 20.16 vs 20.01 Mt. Important References: 47 files re-checked, none new or modified; Outputs/important-references-analysis_2026-10-24.md written (cross-reads of today's findings against the contract triggers). Part C (Task Feedback Log): query for rows not Processed returned zero. Nothing marked, no questions resolved, no mismatches. Part D (Notes & References): newest row by Last Edited is still Night Shift Handover 2026-10-18 (edited Oct 19). Nothing new or edited. Notion tasks created (Inbox, " [ADW]", no Life Area/Project/dates; 9 with Meeting relation to the Oct 24 note): Submit the operations staff list to Jack for driver's license scheduling (Peter); Agree the quarantine of three operators with Jack and have their machine disinfected (Peter); Review James's response and adjust the store plan (Peter); Chase the bulk emulsion supply from MCS; Check the dispatch area generator (frequency above 50 Hz trips the UPS); Request a telehandler from Jack (Peter); Reply again to the IAS email on its restrictions; Collect the 25 damaged Yanmar pumps and send two to Jinta; Confirm the supplier will replace condemned water truck 5952 EBA; Send the proposed operators' CVs to Ma'aden under the Ajeer approval (Peter); Confirm 6 or 10 rental CAT 777E trucks and 6020B or 6028 in the PO-009398 schedule (Peter); Reconcile Oct 23 excavator availability Final Report vs Client Meeting Report (Peter).
